description: This file provides functions for resolving system binaries securely by searching trusted directories based on platform and trust level, with caching and override capabilities.

methods.name: resolveSystemBin
methods.description: Resolves a binary name to an absolute path within trusted directories, with caching and platform-specific logic.

methods.name: _getTrustedDirs
methods.description: Returns the computed trusted directories for binaries based on trust level.

methods.name: _resetResolveSystemBin
methods.description: Clears caches and allows overriding the executable check function, mainly for testing.
